title: phone-page row and watch frame tell a stopped cloud run's ending differently
body: cloudStatusDoc (cloudflare/src/status.ts) maps a cloud run's factory record state "stopped" to lifecycle phase "cancelled", so the phone page's row for a factory-stopped run reads the cancelled class, while the checkout-side Go model for the same run now reads the phase where the epic stands, verdict "stopped", and a needs-you resume (tick jkb's frame). The bare ticfac overview agrees with the phone page (its liveness compensation also renders stopped cloud rows cancelled), so the two ROW classes agree — but the watch frame and the phone page answer one ending with two stories, and hn6's rule 8 says the two renderers of one model cannot disagree. Worth a tick to decide which surface owns the stopped run's story and make the other render it.
